scripts.install-all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../fronted && npm install
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../fronted && npm run build
scripts.setup: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../fronted && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd fronted && npm start"
scripts.test: cd backend && npm test && cd fronted && npm test
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run lint && cd fronted && npm run lint
scripts.seed: npm prefix backend && npm run seed
